harness.notes: js/audio.js is self-contained (no imports). Music is driven by M.tick(dt, night), which the game calls every frame; play therefore starts a 10 ms setInterval. Battle/boss only sound while combatT > 0, so play keeps calling M.combat() every 0.5 s (it sets combatT = 2.5). Mute/volume are read from localStorage 'sc.mute'/'sc.vol' at load.

notes: tick() also starts a quiet looping low-passed wind noise on master (ambience, vol 0.04); it cannot be separated without editing the file, so it will be faintly audible under every track. Field and shrine music are randomly generated phrases (no fixed loop). Battle: 132 bpm half-beat steps, bass cycle 16 steps, pad cycle 32 steps = 16 beats = 7.27 s; boss same at 150 bpm = 6.4 s; village: 16 notes x 0.38 s = 6.08 s. Real step timing drifts slightly with the tick interval (nextAt is measured from the tick that fired). Windborne's js/audio.js is the same code (different localStorage keys).
